# titan2-touchpadd

Product: [github.com/Abyss-c0re/titan2-touchpadd](https://github.com/Abyss-c0re/titan2-touchpadd)  
Mirror: [gitea.angry.im/Abyss-c0re/titan2-touchpadd](https://gitea.angry.im/Abyss-c0re/titan2-touchpadd)  
Upstream: [PeterGSI/titan2-touchpadd](https://gitea.angry.im/PeterGSI/titan2-touchpadd)

Rust source lives in that git. This directory holds AtlasOS overlay (`idc/`, `init/`) and the local musl build (`bin/`).

```bash
./third_party/titan2-touchpadd/fetch.sh
./scripts/build_touchpadd.sh
```

Workshop `titanus2/third_party/titan2-touchpadd` is a symlink to this directory.
ELF is not committed.
